_README: Hand-written truth for the photos we actually took. Fill this in while you
are still standing in the room - nobody can reconstruct it from memory later.
This is NOT produced by the model. It is what we measure the model against:
- object recall  = how many of these the indexer actually found
- attribute accuracy = did it get the colour right
The project brief asks for 'a small evaluation with several test cases', and
this file plus eval/test_queries.json is that deliverable.
Delete the two example entries below once real photos exist.
